name: BMI270 6-axis IMU (accelerometer + gyroscope)
description: Bosch Sensortec ultra-low-power 16-bit 3-axis accelerometer (±2/4/8/16 g) and 3-axis gyroscope (±125 to ±2000 °/s) with I2C/SPI and an on-chip temperature sensor; needs an 8 kB configuration file uploaded after every power-up. Sold as: SparkFun 6DoF IMU Breakout - BMI270 (Qwiic), SEN-22397 (1x1 inch, two Qwiic connectors, two 6-pin 0.1 inch headers on opposite edges: GND, 3V3, SDA, SCL, ADR, CS and ASDX, ASCX, INT1, INT2, OCS, OSDO; no regulator, 1.71-3.6 V; 2.2 kΩ I2C pull-ups), I2C address 0x68 (0x69 with the ADR jumper moved).
eli5: Feels which way is down and how fast it is turning, so your board knows tilt, shakes and spins.

pins.name: 3V3
pins.description: Supply straight to the chip's VDD and VDDIO, 1.71-3.6 V (no regulator on the board: never 5 V)

pins.name: SDA
pins.description: I2C data (SPI PICO/MOSI); 2.2 kΩ pull-up to 3.3 V on the board (I2C jumper)

pins.name: SCL
pins.description: I2C clock (SPI SCK); 2.2 kΩ pull-up to 3.3 V on the board (I2C jumper)

pins.name: ADR
pins.description: Address select (chip SDO, SPI POCI/MISO): 100 kΩ to GND by default = 0x68; ADR jumper to the 3.3 V side = 0x69

pins.name: CS
pins.description: Chip select (CSB), 100 kΩ pull-up = I2C mode; leave unconnected for I2C

pins.name: ASDX
pins.description: Auxiliary I2C data for an external magnetometer (top header pin 1). Not used for basic use

pins.name: ASCX
pins.description: Auxiliary I2C clock for an external magnetometer. Not used for basic use

pins.name: INT1
pins.description: Interrupt output 1 (programmable). Not needed for basic use

pins.name: INT2
pins.description: Interrupt output 2 (programmable). Not needed for basic use

pins.name: OCS
pins.description: OCSB, OIS secondary SPI chip select. Not used for basic use

pins.name: OSDO
pins.description: OIS secondary SPI data out. Not used for basic use

supplierQuery: SparkFun 6DoF IMU Breakout BMI270 Qwiic SEN-22397
buildNotes: Power from 3.3 V only: the 3V3 pin goes straight to the BMI270 (1.71-3.6 V, absolute max 4 V). There is no regulator, so never connect it to 5 V.
The board answers at 0x68 (ADR pulled to GND through 100 kΩ). Move the ADR solder jumper to the 3.3 V side for 0x69. Leave CS unconnected: its 100 kΩ pull-up keeps the chip in I2C mode.
The BMI270 does nothing useful until its 8 kB configuration file is written to INIT_DATA (0x5E) after every power-up or soft reset; the driver carries the blob and checks INTERNAL_STATUS (0x21) = 1.
Data is little-endian two's complement: accel X/Y/Z at 0x0C-0x11, gyro X/Y/Z at 0x12-0x17. The driver sets ±2 g (16384 LSB/g) and ±2000 °/s (16.4 LSB/°/s).
The board has 2.2 kΩ pull-ups on SDA/SCL; cut the I2C jumper if several boards with pull-ups share the bus.
Temperature (0x22) is the die temperature, 23 °C + raw/512; 0x8000 means no valid sample yet.

driver.code:
# BMI270 6-axis IMU (Bosch Sensortec BMI270), MicroPython I2C driver.
# Written from the datasheet BST-BMI270-DS000-08:
#  - CHIP_ID (0x00) reads 0x24.
#  - Initialization (section 4.4): PWR_CONF.adv_power_save = 0, wait >= 450 us, INIT_CTRL = 0x00,
#    burst-write the 8 kB configuration file to INIT_DATA (0x5E) - in chunks, with INIT_ADDR_0/1 (0x5B/0x5C)
#    = chunk offset / 2 before each chunk - then INIT_CTRL = 0x01 (only once per POR / soft reset) and wait
#    until INTERNAL_STATUS (0x21) bits 3..0 = 0b0001 (at most 20 ms).
#  - Normal mode (quick start 3): PWR_CTRL 0x7D = 0x0E, ACC_CONF 0x40 = 0xA8, GYR_CONF 0x42 = 0xA9, PWR_CONF 0x7C = 0x02.
#  - Data (16-bit two's complement, LSB first): accel X/Y/Z 0x0C-0x11, gyro X/Y/Z 0x12-0x17.
#  - ACC_RANGE 0x41: 0=2g 16384, 1=4g 8192, 2=8g 4096, 3=16g 2048 LSB/g.
#  - GYR_RANGE 0x43: 0=2000 16.4, 1=1000 32.8, 2=500 65.6, 3=250 131.2, 4=125 262.4 LSB/(deg/s).
#  - TEMPERATURE 0x22-0x23: 0x0000 = 23 degC, 512 LSB/K, 0x8000 = invalid.
# The configuration blob is bmi270_config_file from Bosch's BMI270_SensorAPI (bmi270.c, BSD-3-Clause,
# Copyright (c) 2023 Bosch Sensortec GmbH), stored base64-encoded below.

import binascii

_CHIP_ID = 0x00
_DATA_ACC = 0x0C
_INTERNAL_STATUS = 0x21
_TEMP = 0x22
_ACC_CONF = 0x40
_ACC_RANGE = 0x41
_GYR_CONF = 0x42
_GYR_RANGE = 0x43
_INIT_CTRL = 0x59
_INIT_ADDR_0 = 0x5B
_INIT_DATA = 0x5E
_PWR_CONF = 0x7C
_PWR_CTRL = 0x7D
_CMD = 0x7E

_ACC = {2: (0x00, 16384.0), 4: (0x01, 8192.0), 8: (0x02, 4096.0), 16: (0x03, 2048.0)}
_GYR = {2000: (0x00, 16.4), 1000: (0x01, 32.8), 500: (0x02, 65.6), 250: (0x03, 131.2), 125: (0x04, 262.4)}

_CHUNK = 256  # bytes per INIT_DATA burst (even, so INIT_ADDR = offset / 2 stays exact)

def _s16(lo, hi):
    v = lo | (hi << 8)
    return v - 65536 if v & 0x8000 else v


class BMI270:
    def __init__(self, i2c, addr=0x68, accel_range=2, gyro_range=2000):
        # SparkFun SEN-22397: ADR is pulled to GND by default (0x68); move the ADR jumper for 0x69.
        self.i2c = i2c
        self.addr = addr
        cid = self._r(_CHIP_ID, 1)[0]
        if cid != 0x24:
            raise OSError('BMI270 not found (chip id 0x%02X): check wiring and address' % cid)
        # Soft reset so the config load (allowed once per reset) also works after a MicroPython soft reboot.
        self._w(_CMD, 0xB6)
        time.sleep_ms(2)
        self._load_config()
        a_code, self._acc_lsb = _ACC[accel_range]
        g_code, self._gyr_lsb = _GYR[gyro_range]
        # Configure while the sensors are still disabled, so the settings apply at once (datasheet 4.6.16).
        self._w(_ACC_CONF, 0xA8)   # performance filter, normal bandwidth, 100 Hz
        self._w(_ACC_RANGE, a_code)
        self._w(_GYR_CONF, 0xA9)   # performance filter, normal bandwidth, 200 Hz
        self._w(_GYR_RANGE, g_code)
        self._w(_PWR_CTRL, 0x0E)   # accelerometer, gyroscope and temperature on
        self._w(_PWR_CONF, 0x02)   # advanced power save off, FIFO self wake-up on
        time.sleep_ms(50)          # gyroscope start-up 45 ms

    def _load_config(self):
        self._w(_PWR_CONF, 0x00)   # advanced power save off
        time.sleep_ms(1)           # >= 450 us
        self._w(_INIT_CTRL, 0x00)  # prepare config load
        cfg = binascii.a2b_base64(_CONFIG_B64)
        if len(cfg) != 8192:
            raise ValueError('BMI270 config blob corrupted')
        mv = memoryview(cfg)
        for i in range(0, len(cfg), _CHUNK):
            w = i // 2
            self.i2c.writeto_mem(self.addr, _INIT_ADDR_0, bytes([w & 0x0F, (w >> 4) & 0xFF]))
            self.i2c.writeto_mem(self.addr, _INIT_DATA, mv[i:i + _CHUNK])
        self._w(_INIT_CTRL, 0x01)  # complete config load
        for _ in range(15):
            time.sleep_ms(20)
            st = self._r(_INTERNAL_STATUS, 1)[0] & 0x0F
            if st == 0x01:
                return
        raise OSError('BMI270 initialization failed (INTERNAL_STATUS message %d)' % st)

    def _w(self, reg, val):
        self.i2c.writeto_mem(self.addr, reg, bytes([val]))

    def _r(self, reg, n):
        return self.i2c.readfrom_mem(self.addr, reg, n)

    def read(self):
        """Return ((ax, ay, az) in g, (gx, gy, gz) in deg/s), read in one burst."""
        d = self._r(_DATA_ACC, 12)
        a = tuple(_s16(d[i], d[i + 1]) / self._acc_lsb for i in (0, 2, 4))
        g = tuple(_s16(d[i], d[i + 1]) / self._gyr_lsb for i in (6, 8, 10))
        return a, g

    def acceleration(self):
        return self.read()[0]

    def gyro(self):
        return self.read()[1]

    def temperature(self):
        """Die temperature in degC, or None while no valid sample exists (raw 0x8000)."""
        d = self._r(_TEMP, 2)
        raw = _s16(d[0], d[1])
        if raw == -32768:
            return None
        return 23 + raw / 512

example.code:
from machine import I2C, Pin
import time
from bmi270 import BMI270

i2c = I2C({I2C_ID}, sda=Pin({SDA}), scl=Pin({SCL}), freq=400000)
imu = BMI270(i2c)  # 0x68 on the SparkFun board (ADR jumper default)
while True:
    (ax, ay, az), (gx, gy, gz) = imu.read()
    t = imu.temperature()
    ts = '--' if t is None else '%.1f' % t
    print('A=%.2f,%.2f,%.2fg G=%.1f,%.1f,%.1fdps T=%sC' % (ax, ay, az, gx, gy, gz, ts))
    time.sleep(1)
